points.place: 乌克兰叶利萨维特格勒
points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 季诺维也夫出生于乌克兰叶利萨特格勒的一个犹太人家庭，原名奥夫谢伊·格尔施科维奇·阿罗诺维奇·拉德尼科夫。他的父亲是一个牛奶场主，家境相对富裕。季诺维也夫接受了良好的教育，在当地的犹太学校学习，后来进入一所中学。这一时期，他接触到了革命思想，开始对沙皇专制制度产生不满。这段早期生活为他后来投身革命事业奠定了基础，也塑造了他作为知识型革命者的身份。
points.descriptionEn: Zinoviev was born in Yelisavetgrad, Ukraine (now Kropyvnytskyi) to a Jewish family. His father was a dairy farmer with a relatively comfortable background. Zinoviev received a good education, first in a Jewish school and later in a gymnasium. During this period, he was exposed to revolutionary ideas and developed an opposition to the Tsarist autocracy. This early life laid the foundation for his later revolutionary career and shaped his identity as an intellectual revolutionary.

points.title: 革命活动家
points.description: 季诺维也夫加入俄国社会民主工党，成为布尔什维克派的重要成员。他多次被捕和流放，但始终坚持革命活动。1905年革命期间，他积极参与组织工作，成为列宁的亲密战友和重要助手。1912年，他当选为俄国社会民主工党中央委员会委员，负责党的宣传工作。1917年二月革命后，季诺维也夫与列宁一起从瑞士返回俄国，并在布尔什维克党内的地位日益提升。这一时期，他展现了出色的组织才能和理论水平，成为党内的重要理论家和宣传家。
points.descriptionEn: Zinoviev joined the Russian Social Democratic Labor Party and became an important member of the Bolshevik faction. He was arrested and exiled multiple times but remained committed to revolutionary activities. During the 1905 Revolution, he actively participated in organizational work and became a close comrade and assistant to Lenin. In 1912, he was elected to the Central Committee of the RSDLP, responsible for the party's propaganda work. After the February Revolution in 1917, Zinoviev returned to Russia with Lenin and his influence within the Bolshevik Party grew significantly. During this period, he demonstrated outstanding organizational skills and theoretical knowledge, becoming an important theorist and propagandist within the party.

points.place: 俄罗斯彼得格勒/莫斯科
points.title: 十月革命与内战
points.description: 十月革命期间，季诺维也夫是彼得格勒苏维埃主席，领导了武装起义。革命胜利后，他担任彼得格勒苏维埃主席和全俄中央执行委员会主席，成为苏维埃政权的重要领导人之一。1919年，他当选为共产国际执行委员会主席，成为国际共产主义运动的核心人物。在俄国内战期间，季诺维也夫负责彼得格勒地区的防御工作，对抗白军和外国干涉军。1921年，他参与镇压喀琅施塔得水兵起义。这一时期，季诺维也夫与斯大林、加米涅夫等人组成'三驾马车'，共同领导布尔什维克党，对抗托洛茨基的挑战。
points.descriptionEn: During the October Revolution, Zinoviev was chairman of the Petrograd Soviet and led the armed uprising. After the revolution's success, he served as chairman of the Petrograd Soviet and the All-Russian Central Executive Committee, becoming one of the key leaders of the Soviet regime. In 1919, he was elected chairman of the Executive Committee of the Communist International, becoming a central figure in the international communist movement. During the Russian Civil War, Zinoviev was responsible for the defense of the Petrograd region against White Army and foreign intervention forces. In 1921, he participated in suppressing the Kronstadt Rebellion. During this period, Zinoviev formed a 'troika' with Stalin and Kamenev to jointly lead the Bolshevik Party against Trotsky's challenges.

points.title: 权力斗争与失势
points.description: 随着斯大林权力的巩固，季诺维也夫与加米涅夫逐渐失去影响力。1925年，他们联合反对斯大林日益增长的权力，但被击败。1926年，季诺维也夫被解除共产国际主席职务，1927年被开除出党，后恢复党籍但被降职。1929年，他再次被开除出党，后被流放。季诺维也夫与托洛茨基虽然曾共同反对斯大林，但两人之间存在深刻的理论分歧。这一时期，季诺维也夫在政治上逐渐边缘化，他的政治生涯开始走向衰落。他的失势标志着党内反对斯大林的力量被彻底清除，斯大林开始确立其在党内的绝对领导地位。
points.descriptionEn: As Stalin consolidated his power, Zinoviev and Kamenev gradually lost influence. In 1925, they united to oppose Stalin's growing power but were defeated. In 1926, Zinoviev was removed as chairman of the Comintern and in 1927 expelled from the party, though he was later reinstated but demoted. In 1929, he was expelled from the party again and subsequently exiled. Although Zinoviev and Trotsky had jointly opposed Stalin, they had deep theoretical differences. During this period, Zinoviev was politically marginalized, and his political career began to decline. His fall marked the complete elimination of anti-Stalin forces within the party and the beginning of Stalin's absolute leadership.

points.title: 大清洗与处决
points.description: 1934年基洛夫被暗杀后，季诺维也夫被卷入大清洗运动。1935年，他被指控参与暗杀基洛夫的阴谋，被判处10年监禁。1936年，在第一次莫斯科审判中，季诺维也夫与加米涅夫等人被指控与托洛茨基勾结，阴谋推翻斯大林政权。在审判中，他被迫认罪，被判处死刑并于8月25日被处决。季诺维也夫的处决标志着大清洗运动的高潮，也象征着斯大林对党内老布尔什维克的彻底清算。他的死不仅是个人悲剧，也象征着苏联革命理想与现实的悲剧性断裂。
points.descriptionEn: After the assassination of Kirov in 1934, Zinoviev was caught up in the Great Purge. In 1935, he was accused of involvement in the conspiracy to assassinate Kirov and sentenced to 10 years in prison. In 1936, during the first Moscow Trial, Zinoviev and Kamenev were accused of colluding with Trotsky to overthrow Stalin's regime. During the trial, he was forced to confess and was sentenced to death, executed on August 25. Zinoviev's execution marked the peak of the Great Purge and symbolized Stalin's complete清算 of the old Bolsheviks. His death was not only a personal tragedy but also symbolized the tragic rupture between Soviet revolutionary ideals and reality.

supporter.zh: 季诺维也夫被视为十月革命的重要功臣和坚定的马克思主义者。支持者认为他在革命初期和内战期间发挥了关键作用，特别是在彼得格勒的防御工作中。作为共产国际的首任主席，他帮助推动了国际共产主义运动的发展。支持者强调，季诺维也夫的悲剧性结局反映了斯大林主义对革命理想的背叛，而非他本人的过错。他的政治生涯展现了早期布尔什维克党内的民主讨论氛围，以及后来被斯大林个人独裁所取代的历史过程。
supporter.en: Zinoviev is regarded as a key contributor to the October Revolution and a steadfast Marxist. Supporters believe he played a crucial role in the early revolutionary period and during the Civil War, particularly in the defense of Petrograd. As the first chairman of the Comintern, he helped advance the international communist movement. Supporters emphasize that Zinoviev's tragic outcome reflects the betrayal of revolutionary ideals by Stalinism, rather than his own faults. His political career exemplifies the democratic discussion atmosphere within the early Bolshevik Party, which was later replaced by Stalin's personal dictatorship.

critic.zh: 批评者认为季诺维也夫是一个机会主义者和政治投机者。他们指出，他在与斯大林的权力斗争中缺乏原则性，多次改变立场以适应政治需要。批评者还指责他在镇压喀琅施塔得起义等事件中的强硬立场，以及在大清洗初期对斯大林政策的支持。季诺维也夫被批评为未能有效抵抗斯大林的独裁倾向，反而助长了党内恐怖氛围。他的政治生涯被视为革命理想被权力欲望腐蚀的典型案例，最终自己也成为了自己曾参与建立的恐怖制度的受害者。
critic.en: Critics view Zinoviev as an opportunist and political climber. They point out his lack of principle in power struggles with Stalin, frequently changing positions to suit political needs. Critics also accuse him of his hardline stance in events like the suppression of the Kronstadt Rebellion and his support for Stalin's policies during the early stages of the Great Purge. Zinoviev is criticized for failing to effectively resist Stalin's dictatorial tendencies and instead contributing to the party's climate of terror. His political career is seen as a典型案例 of revolutionary ideals being corrupted by the desire for power, ultimately making him a victim of the terror system he had helped establish.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，季诺维也夫被视为苏联早期政治复杂性的典型代表。他的生平反映了从相对民主的党内讨论到斯大林个人独裁的转变过程。作为历史人物，他既不是简单的英雄也不是纯粹的恶棍，而是一个在特定历史条件下做出复杂选择的革命者。在流行文化中，季诺维也夫常被描绘为大清洗运动的早期受害者，他的命运成为斯大林时代政治恐怖的象征。他的生平也引发了关于革命理想与现实政治之间张力的讨论，以及权力如何腐蚀最初革命者的思考。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Zinoviev is regarded as a typical representative of the complexity of early Soviet politics. His life reflects the transition from relatively democratic intra-party discussions to Stalin's personal dictatorship. As a historical figure, he is neither a simple hero nor a pure villain, but a revolutionary who made complex choices under specific historical conditions. In popular culture, Zinoviev is often depicted as an early victim of the Great Purge, his fate becoming a symbol of political terror in the Stalin era. His life also sparks discussions about the tension between revolutionary ideals and realpolitik, and how power can corrupt original revolutionaries.

self.zh: 革命不是请客吃饭，不是做文章，不是绘画绣花，不能那样雅致，那样从容不迫，文质彬彬，那样温良恭俭让。
self.en: Revolution is not a dinner party, or an essay, or a painting, or a piece of embroidery; it cannot be so refined, so leisurely and gentle, so temperate, kind, courteous, restrained and magnanimous.

others.zh: 季诺维也夫是一个聪明但缺乏原则的人，他总是能够找到最符合自己利益的政治立场，无论这立场与他的过去有多么矛盾。
others.en: Zinoviev was a clever but unprincipled man who could always find the political position most advantageous to himself, no matter how contradictory it was to his past.
